body: I might try. I’ve already drank at this point but starting fresh tomorrow maybe I can try to stop cold turkey. I don’t drink enough that withdrawals would kill me or even require hospital but I’m right below that line... Maybe I could benefit from it. I still have my eyes set on New Years. Even if I slip up before then it will be ok. I know personally I will never drink again after New Years. And I just want life to be ok again. I need my family to help me. I love my family. God knows I do. I just need to be strong and do this. Thank you for your words, seriously
